payload.text: Final implementation: deterministic native Three.js WebGPU scene with ivory stucco aperture walls, inset framed glazing, panelled door, two-post tiled porch, modelled terracotta barrel tiles and lips, vented chimney, gutters and downpipes, irregular paving, masonry garden boundary, mailbox, cedar side gate, branching olive trees, instanced leaves and lavender, grass accents, curved road with curbs and broken markings, and a contoured blue hatchback with four detailed wheels, glazing, lights, mirrors, door seams, trim and clearcoat. The adapter uses controlled native submissions without an animation loop or extra GPU fences and copies all rendered mesh buffers and actual instance/world matrices. Three preview builds passed native rendering and numeric geometry export preflight. Final build passes pnpm run build. Final placement, stone texture and paint refinements occurred after preview 3; no preview slots remain. Limitations: the materials and vegetation are procedural and the car is an authored approximation rather than a manufacturer-exact model. All author command process groups have exited; no persistent application server or browser was started by the author.
